description: Production questions; current unresolved problem gate and evidence-supported opportunity scoring remain unchanged.

genuine.instructions: Does this text report a concrete, current unresolved problem experienced by an affected person? Answer no for resumes, recruitment, product marketing, general advice, hypothetical needs, or resolved achievements. Promotional mentions of problems alone do not qualify.

first_hand.instructions: Does the speaker explicitly report their own experience?

workaround.instructions: Is an existing workaround explicitly described?

loss.instructions: Is time or money loss explicitly described?

willingness_to_pay.instructions: Does the speaker explicitly say they pay or would pay to solve this problem? Do not infer willingness from frustration.

severity.instructions: How severe is the explicitly described impact?
criteria: Critical livelihood, safety or business impact

category.instructions: Which industry best matches this problem?

criteria.hospitality: Restaurants, hotels, catering and food service
criteria.services: Professional services and small business administration
